summary: Built the code generation system that converts visual workflows into executable LangChain TypeScript code. Implemented template-based generators for each node type (upload, extract, transform, output), topological sort with cycle detection for correct execution ordering, import deduplication/sorting, variable name formatting, and a CodeGenerator service that orchestrates validation, chain assembly, and code output with error handling, logging, and file headers. All 44 tests pass, zero TypeScript errors in new code, and generation completes well under 500ms for 50+ node workflows.
